source: Bordik Med — bedside procedural reference для NICU nursing + feldsher (audit Ж1-3, З1-3)
license: Образовательный материал. Каждое процедурное руководство ссылается на institutional NICU protocol.

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Newborn-size mask: правильный размер (cover nose + mouth, не глаза)
Self-inflating bag (Ambu) ИЛИ flow-inflating bag ИЛИ T-piece (Neopuff)
PEEP valve attached если flow-inflating / T-piece

steps.title: Position
items: Sniffing position (нейтральная шея с лёгким разгибанием)
Shoulder roll если нужен (особенно у больших babies)

steps.title: Mask fit
items: C+E grip: thumb + index = C around mask, остальные 3 = E под jaw
Mask seal без leak (слышен hiss = поправить)
НЕ нажимать сильно на trachea (compresses airway)

steps.title: Ventilate
items: PEEP 5 см H₂O (если on PEEP valve)

steps.title: Verify ventilation
items: Если нет rise: M-R SOPA (mask, reposition, suction, open mouth, pressure ↑, alternative airway)

warnings: Excessive pressure (> 30 см H₂O) — pneumothorax risk
Excessive volume — barotrauma
НЕ ventilate новорождённого при наличии активного withdrawal (например, DCC ≥ 60 sec у term)
Если apnea > 30 sec несмотря adequate PPV — call for help, prepare intubation
references: Aziz K et al. Pediatrics 2021;147:e2020038505E — NRP 8 ed.

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Suction catheter правильного размера: 6 Fr (preterm), 8 Fr (term), 10 Fr (large term)

steps.title: Indication только при obstruction
items: Insufficient ventilation несмотря good mask seal
НЕ routine у asymptomatic newborn (даже после meconium staining у vigorous infant)

steps.title: Procedure
items: Mouth first, затем nose (avoid stimulating gag reflex first)
Insert catheter без suction (depth: к pharynx — около 5 см у term)
Apply suction только при withdrawal (rotating motion)

steps.title: Меконий-staining (NRP 8 ed.)
items: Vigorous (good cry/tone, HR > 100): НЕ tracheal suctioning routinely
Non-vigorous (apnea/poor tone/HR < 100): standard PPV first; intubate + tracheal suction только если PPV не effective

warnings: Vagal stimulation → bradycardia при deep / aggressive suctioning
Mucosal trauma + nosebleed
Hypoxia от prolonged suction
НЕ routine deep tracheal suction (NRP 8 ed. изменено с 2015)
references: AARC Clinical Practice Guideline — Endotracheal Suctioning

steps.title: Site selection
items: Avoid: feet (если crawling age), areas of skin damage

steps.title: Position + comfort
items: Skin-to-skin или held by parent если возможно
Pacifier + sucrose 0.5 мл oral 2 мин до procedure

steps.title: Procedure
items: Skin prep с chlorhexidine, allow dry
Stretch skin distal к insertion site
Insert needle bevel up at 10-30° angle
Advance until flash of blood в hub
Reduce angle, advance catheter (NOT needle) over needle
Flush с 0.5-1 мл NS slowly — verify patency (no swelling, no resistance)

warnings: Extravasation — frequent assessment q1h; severe agents (Ca gluconate, hyperosmolar TPN, vasopressors) НЕ peripheral
Air embolism при flush с воздухом
Phlebitis — early sign change site
Thrombosis — assess pulse distal к catheter daily

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Polyurethane preferred (less trauma vs PVC, но более expensive)
pH paper если available (verify gastric placement)

steps.title: Measure depth
items: NEX method: nose → earlobe → xiphoid + 1 cm
У ELBW: NEMU (nose → ear → mid-umbilicus) более accurate (Ellett 2011)

steps.title: Insertion
items: Insert в одну ноздрю slowly (не force)
Stop если resistance — try other ноздрю
Watch for cyanosis / coughing / vomiting (withdraw if persistent)
Secure с tape (avoid pulling on cheek)

steps.title: Verification — perform BEFORE feeding/medication
items: Aspirate gastric contents — pH ≤ 5.5 (gastric); pH > 5.5 ambiguous
X-ray confirmation для feeding tube — gold standard, но не routine после first placement
Re-verify pH перед каждым feeding если bedside available

steps.title: Maintenance
items: Replace q72h ИЛИ per institutional protocol
Flush с 1-2 мл of водой between meds + feedings
Aspirate slowly с 5-10 мл syringe (большие — vacuum trauma)

warnings: Misplacement в trachea / lungs — dangerous (verify pH or X-ray)
Esophageal perforation rare но возможна
Vagal stimulation → bradycardia
Aspiration risk при wrong placement
references: Ellett ML et al. J Pediatr Nurs 2011;26:329 — NEMU method

steps.title: Frequency
items: Stable term newborn: q4h первые 24 ч, затем q8h

steps.title: Heart rate (HR)
items: Bradycardia < 100 — assess for cause + inform physician
Tachycardia > 180 — fever, pain, dehydration, sepsis, CHF

steps.title: Respiratory rate (RR)
items: Tachypnea > 60 sustained — RDS, sepsis, CHF, cold stress
Bradypnea < 30 — apnea risk, sedation, neuro injury
Periodic breathing (pauses < 10 sec без bradycardia/desat) — normal

steps.title: Temperature
items: Axillary (preferred, safest) ИЛИ rectal (если more accurate needed)
Skin probe servo-control когда in incubator

steps.title: Blood pressure
items: NIBP cuff: правильный размер (cuff width = 1/2 окружности arm)
Routine: 1-2 раза/d у stable term; q4h у NICU; continuous arterial line у critical
Normal MAP ≈ GA в нед (e.g., 30 нед PMA → MAP ≥ 30)
Higher MAP target у HIE / cardiac issues

steps.title: SpO₂ targets
items: Pre-ductal preferred (right hand) для CCHD screening
Continuous monitoring у all NICU patients

warnings: Crying / agitation → falsely elevated HR / RR — recheck after settled
Cold extremity → SpO₂ probe poor signal — reposition или warm
Tight cuff → falsely high BP
Sepsis может presenting только subtle vital signs change — high index suspicion

steps.title: Frequency (по риску)
items: High risk (IDM, LGA, SGA, asphyxia): q30 мин first 2 ч, then q1-2h × 12 ч
Moderate risk (late preterm, no feed established): q1-2h × 12 ч, q3-4h до 48 ч

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Sterile lancet (depth 1 mm preterm; 2 mm term)

steps.title: Site selection
items: Lateral or medial PLANTAR aspect heel (avoid posterior heel — calcaneus)

steps.title: Stick procedure
items: Clean site с alcohol — let dry
Brief, single, decisive stick at 90° к skin
Allow large second drop без squeezing (squeeze contaminates with tissue fluid → falsely low)
Direct pressure с gauze post-stick × 30 sec

steps.title: Action thresholds
items: < 1.7 ммоль/л symptomatic ИЛИ < 1.4 asymptomatic первые 4 ч → confirm + treat
Always confirm POC < 2.5 with serum lab

warnings: Squeeze foot — falsely low glucose (tissue fluid)
Repeated sticks same site — bruising, calcaneal injury
POC glucometers overestimate low values у polycythemia + дегидратации
Pain — use analgesia (sucrose ± skin-to-skin)
references: Thornton PS et al. J Pediatr 2015;167:238 — PES 2015

steps.title: Equipment
items: LED phototherapy unit (preferred — wavelength 460-490 nm, low heat)

steps.title: Setup
items: Distance light source: 35-50 cm (LED) или 50 cm (conventional)
Cover eyes carefully (НЕ обмотать слишком туго — corneal abrasion risk)
Reposition q2h: front, back, side для uniform exposure

steps.title: Maintenance care
items: Continue feeding — НЕ stop unless TSB > exchange threshold
Skin-to-skin OK для 30-60 мин при breaks (eye shields off briefly)
Monitor T core (overheating risk if not LED)
Hydration assessment — dry skin, fontanelle, urine output

steps.title: Monitoring TSB
items: Repeat TSB q4-6h в active phase
Stop когда TSB < 2 мг/дл below PT threshold
Recheck TSB в 12-24 ч after stop (rebound risk)

warnings: Eye damage если shield слишком туго (corneal abrasion) или slips off (retinal damage)
Hyperthermia если не-LED + close distance
Dehydration — increased insensible water losses (IWL) ~10-20 % above baseline
НЕ phototherapy при cholestasis (direct hyperbilirubinemia) — "bronze baby syndrome"
Skin photo-darkening transient — не concerning
references: Kemper AR et al. Pediatrics 2022;150(3):e2022058859 — AAP 2022

steps.title: Prong sizing
items: Правильный размер: prong fills nare без stretching skin
Too large — pressure necrosis nasal septum

steps.title: Positioning
items: Prongs angled slightly downward (follows nasal passage anatomy)
Tape / Tegaderm к cheeks для secure без traction
Avoid pulling prongs deep — septum trauma

steps.title: Maintenance
items: Inspect nares + septum q2-4h (rotate prong slightly)
Saline drops 1-2 капли q4-6h prn для secretions
Gentle suction prn (но не routine — irritates mucosa)
Skin protective barrier (Mepilex Lite, Cavilon spray)

steps.title: Skin checks
items: Septum: redness, blanching, breakdown — early signs critical
При первых признаках — rotate prongs, change taping technique, reduce pressure if possible

warnings: Septal necrosis / column deformity — common iatrogenic injury (5-25 % CPAP infants without rotation/protective)
Nasal obstruction → CPAP failure
Air leak from mouth → ineffective CPAP (consider chin strap, pacifier)
Gastric distention — vent G-tube или OG tube placed for decompression
references: Sweet DG et al. Neonatology 2023;120:3 — European Consensus RDS
